'''Sharoleigh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], she learned that a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] was training [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. When she feared that this could swell the ranks of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and tip the balance from the Empire, she sent an Imperial-allied individual to the Jedi training facility to wipe them out.
